'''Red Hawk Takes a Dove''' is a [[sword form]]. It was used by [[Eamon Valda]] during the [[Trial Beneath the Light]] against [[Galadedrid Damodred]]. Valda caused a shallow gash on Galad's left arm using this form.{{ref/book|11|p}}
